design.scope: within-sleeve weighting paths on composite top20 KR-equity sleeve only

composite_z_construction_inherited_from_.selection_rule: top20 by composite_z descending per sig_date

path_B_Z_linear.label: Z-tilted linear within sleeve
path_B_Z_linear.rationale: Stocks with higher composite_z get proportionally more weight; negative z stocks would get 0 (rare in top20)

path_C_Z_softmax.label: Z-tilted softmax within sleeve, tau auto-selected
path_C_Z_softmax.tau_selection: median(|composite_z_in_top20|) per sig_date (autonomous, balance EW vs winner-take-all)
path_C_Z_softmax.tau_rationale: Low tau → concentrated tilt when z signals are clear; high tau → EW-like when z signals are flat. Median(|z|) is data-driven equivalent of 1-sigma scale.
path_C_Z_softmax.numerical_stability: subtract max(z_scaled) before exp for stability

cap_enforcement.enforcement: iterative cap + proportional redistribution to non-capped stocks (max 50 iterations)

cost_model.round_trip_calc: 2 × turnover_oneway × 15bps at SLEEVE level → multiplied by sleeve outer weight (0.55) for portfolio drag
cost_model.turnover_definition: per-ticker weight delta sum / 2 (NOT just name swap) — captures Path B/C continuous weight drift even when ticker set unchanged

constraints_compliance.single_asset_cap_0p20: STRICT enforce Paths B/C; Path A trivially satisfies
constraints_compliance.PIT_C1_to_C15: inherited from PD20-B (C1-C12+C15 strict; C13/C14 inherits alpha-layer pending)
